ABOUT THIS EDITION

The Open Lingala Contemporary Bible, known as Mokanda na Bomoi ("Book of Life"), is a full Bible translation in contemporary Lingala produced by Biblica (International Bible Society). The translation project began in 1992, and a New Testament was published in 2002 (with copyright date reflecting this milestone). Work on the complete Bible continued from 2003, with several interruptions and changes in team composition over the project's nearly 30-year lifespan; over 50 people contributed to the translation. The full Bible was officially launched on August 7, 2021, at the Cathédrale du Centenaire Protestant in Kinshasa, DR Congo, in partnership with the Église du Christ au Congo (ECC), the umbrella organization overseeing evangelical churches in the DRC. Charles Diawaku, Biblica's former Director, organized the launch, with Biblica staff Thomas Amoah (Regional Director for West Africa) and Rose Birenge (Partnerships Director) in attendance. Scripture Union served as the commercial distribution partner. The edition carries copyright dates of 2002 and 2020 and is distributed through Biblica's Open.Bible initiative under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike license, with text and audio editions covering both the Old and New Testaments. Lingala, a Bantu trade language that developed around 1900, is a statutory language of national identity in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and serves as a major lingua franca, spoken by around 20 million people.

La Parole faite chair

John 1

John 4

La guérison à la piscine de Béthesda

John 5

Un jour de sabbat, Jésus guérit un homme infirme depuis trente-huit ans. Quand les chefs s'y opposent, Jésus déclare que le Fils donne la vie et accomplit les œuvres de son Père.

John 6

Le pain de vie

John 6

John 6

Le pain de vie

Jésus nourrit cinq mille personnes avec cinq pains et deux poissons, puis marche sur la mer pour rejoindre ses disciples. Se déclarant le pain de vie, il voit beaucoup se détourner, tandis que Pierre confesse que lui seul a les paroles de la vie éternelle.

La lumière du monde

John 8

John 16

ew Testament in Lingala, a Bantu vehicular language spoken by roughly 20 million people along the middle Congo River in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of the Congo, where it is one of four national languages of DRC alongside Kikongo, Tshiluba, and Swahili. Lingala originated as a simplified trade form of Bobangi in the late 19th century and was spread along river and military routes during the Belgian colonial period.

Lingala Scripture began with Protestant mission work on the upper Congo. The American Baptist Foreign Mission Society and the Congo Balolo Mission produced early Gospel portions in the 1900s, and a New Testament followed in 1922. Catholic Lingala Scripture took shape through the Scheutists and the Jesuits, with a Catholic Lingala New Testament published mid-century. Subsequent revisions have been coordinated by the Alliance biblique du Congo in Kinshasa, the Congolese United Bible Societies member (Meeuwis 2010).

The Lingala New Testament circulating today is printed in Latin script with tone marks on pedagogical editions and without them in most popular printings. The text is used in worship by Catholic, Kimbanguist, Protestant, and Pentecostal churches along the Congo river corridor and in the two capitals, Kinshasa and Brazzaville. It is also the language of Congolese rumba hymnody, which gives Lingala Scripture passages wide popular familiarity.

24
Yesu asekwi
( Mat 28.1-9; Mlk 16.1-8; Yn 20.1-13)

1 Na tongo-tongo ya mokolo ya liboso ya poso, basi bakendeki na kunda mpe bamemaki mafuta ya solo kitoko oyo balambaki. 2 Libanga oyo ekangaki ekotelo ya kunda, bakutaki yango etindikama mosika na ekotelo ya kunda. 3 Bakotaki, kasi bamonaki te nzoto ya Nkolo Yesu. 4 Wana bazalaki nanu komitungisa mpo na likambo yango, bato mibale babimelaki bango, balata bilamba oyo ezali kongenga makasi. 5 Basi yango babangaki, bakitisaki bilongi na bango na ngambo ya mabele ; kasi bato wana mibale balobaki na bango :

— Mpo na nini bozali koluka kati na bakufi Ye oyo azali na bomoi ? 6 Azali lisusu awa te, asekwi. Bokanisa makambo oyo ayebisaki bino, wana azalaki nanu kati na Galile : 7 « Esengeli ete bakaba Mwana na Moto na maboko ya bato ya masumu ; esengeli ete babaka Ye na ekulusu ; mpe esengeli ete asekwa sima na mikolo misato. »

8 Boye, bakanisaki maloba ya Yesu.

9 Tango bazongaki longwa na kunda, bayebisaki makambo wana nyonso epai ya bayekoli zomi na moko mpe epai ya baninga na bango nyonso. 10 Ezalaki  : Mari, moto ya mboka Magidala ; Jane mpe Mari, mama ya Jake. Baninga na bango mosusu ya basi bayebisaki mpe makambo yango epai ya bantoma, 11 kasi bazwaki maloba ya basi yango lokola maloba ezanga tina, mpe bandimaki bango te.

12 Kasi Petelo atelemaki mpe apotaki mbangu kino na kunda. Agunzamaki mpo na kotala, amonaki kaka biteni ya elamba ya lino elala yango moko. Alongwaki kuna mpe azongaki, akamwaki makasi makambo oyo ewutaki kosalema.

Yesu abimeli bayekoli na nzela ya Emausi

13 Nzokande, kaka na mokolo yango, mibale kati na bango bazalaki kokende na mboka moko oyo kombo na yango ezalaki « Emausi. » Mboka yango ezalaki mosika na Yelusalemi, na bakilometele pene zomi na mibale. 14 Bazalaki kosolola na tina na makambo nyonso oyo ewuti kosalema. 15 Wana bazalaki kosolola mpe kotiana tembe mpo na makambo yango, Yesu asanganaki na bango mpe akomaki kokende na bango nzela moko. 16 Kasi lokola miso na bango ezalaki ya kozipama, bakokaki te kososola ete ezali Yesu.

17 Alobaki na bango  :

— Makambo nini bozali kotiana na yango tembe na kotambola ?

Batelemaki, bilongi mawa-mawa. 18 Moko kati na bango, kombo na ye « Kleopasi, » alobaki na Ye :

— Kati na bavandi nyonso ya Yelusalemi, yo moko kaka oyebi te makambo oyo ewuti kosalema mikolo oyo !

19 Yesu atunaki bango  :

— Makambo nini ?

Bazongisaki  :

— Ezali makambo oyo etali Yesu ya Nazareti : azalaki mosakoli moko ya nguya, na misala mpe na maloba, liboso ya Nzambe mpe liboso ya bato nyonso. 20 Kasi bakonzi ya Banganga-Nzambe mpe bakambi na biso bakabaki Ye mpo ete bakatela Ye etumbu ya kufa, mpe babakaki Ye na ekulusu. 21 Tozalaki kolikya ete Ye nde akokangola Isalaele. Kasi longola nyonso wana, lelo ezali mokolo ya misato wuta makambo wana esalemaki.

22 Lisusu, ndambo ya basi kati na biso bakamwisi biso makasi ; bakendeki na kunda na tongo-tongo, 23 kasi bamonaki nzoto na Ye te, mpe bayaki koyebisa biso ete bamonaki ba-anjelu kobimela bango mpe koyebisa bango ete Yesu azali na bomoi. 24 Ndambo kati na baninga na biso bakendeki na kunda, mpe makambo oyo bamonaki kuna ekokani penza na oyo basi balobaki, kasi bamonaki Yesu te.

25 Yesu alobaki na bango  :

— Ah ! Bozali penza bazoba ! Tala ndenge mitema na bino ezali penza mabanga ! Bozali penza kondima te makambo nyonso oyo basakoli baloba ! 26 Boni, Klisto asengelaki te komona pasi ndenge wana mpo ete akota kati na nkembo na Ye ?

27 Bongo Yesu alimbolelaki bango makambo nyonso oyo ekomama kati na Makomi, kobanda na Moyize kino na basakoli nyonso.

28 Tango bakomaki pene ya mboka epai wapi bazalaki kokende, Yesu asalaki lokola nde azali kokende mosika. 29 Kasi bango babondelaki Ye makasi  :

— Vanda elongo na biso, pamba te pokwa esili kokoma, mpe butu elingi kokota.

Boye Yesu akotaki na ndako mpo na kovanda elongo na bango. 30 Tango avandaki na mesa elongo na bango, akamataki lipa, azongisaki matondi epai ya Nzambe, akataki yango na biteni, mpe apesaki bango yango. 31 Mbala moko, miso na bango efungwamaki mpe basosolaki ete ezali Yesu, kasi alimwaki na miso na bango. 32 Batunanaki  :

— Boni, mitema na biso etondaki na esengo te wana azalaki kosolola na biso na nzela mpe kolimbolela biso Makomi ?

33 Kaka na tango yango, batelemaki mpe bazongaki na Yelusalemi epai wapi bakutaki bayekoli zomi na moko basangana elongo na baninga na bango, 34 oyo balobaki na bango  :

— Ezali ya solo, Nkolo asekwi ; abimelaki Simona !

35 Bango mibale mpe bayebisaki makambo oyo ekomelaki bango na nzela mpe ndenge nini basosolaki Yesu tango akataki lipa na biteni.

Yesu abimeli bayekoli zomi na moko
( Yn 20.19-23)

36 Wana bazalaki nanu kosolola na tina na makambo yango, Yesu ayaki kotelema na kati-kati na bango mpe alobaki :

— Tika ete kimia ezala na bino !

37 Babangaki mpe somo ekangaki bango, pamba te bakanisaki ete bamoni elima.

38 Yesu atunaki bango  :

— Mpo na nini bozali kobanga ? Mpe mpo na nini bozali na tembe kati na mitema na bino ? 39 Botala maboko mpe makolo na Ngai  ; ezali penza Ngai. Bosimba Ngai mpe botala ! Elima ezalaka na mosuni te, ezalaka mpe na mikuwa te ; nzokande, bozali komona malamu ete, Ngai, nazali na yango.

40 Wana azalaki koloba bongo, alakisaki bango maboko mpe makolo na Ye. 41 Lokola bakokaki nanu kondima te mpo ete batondisamaki na esengo mpe bazalaki kokamwa mingi, Yesu atunaki bango :

— Bozali awa na eloko ya kolia ?

42 Bapesaki Ye eteni ya mbisi bakalinga. 43 Azwaki yango mpe aliaki yango na miso na bango.

44 Bongo alobaki na bango  :

— Yango nde makambo oyo nayebisaki bino tango nazalaki nanu elongo na bino : « Makambo nyonso oyo ekomama na tina na Ngai kati na Mobeko ya Moyize, kati na mikanda ya basakoli mpe kati na banzembo, esengeli kokokisama. »

45 Bongo afungolaki bango mayele mpo ete bakoka kososola Makomi.

46 Alobaki na bango  :

— Tala makambo oyo ekomama : « Klisto akomona pasi, mpe akosekwa kati na bakufi na mokolo ya misato ; 47 mpe, na Kombo na Ye, bakoteya bato ya bikolo nyonso, kobanda na Yelusalemi, ete babongola mitema mpo ete bazwa bolimbisi ya masumu. » 48 Bino nde bozali batatoli ya makambo yango. 49 Ngai nakotindela bino Molimo oyo Tata na Ngai alakaki  ; boye bino, botikala awa, kati na engumba oyo, kino bokotondisama na nguya ya Likolo.

( Mlk 16.19; Mis 1.4-14)

50 Yesu amemaki bango na libanda ya engumba, pene ya Betani ; mpe kuna, atombolaki maboko mpe apambolaki bango.

51 Wana azalaki kopambola bango, akabwanaki na bango mpe amemamaki kati na Likolo.

52 Bongo bagumbamelaki Ye mpe bazongaki na Yelusalemi na esengo makasi. 53 Mpe kuna na Yelusalemi, bazalaki kovanda tango nyonso kati na lopango ya Tempelo mpo na kokumisa Nzambe.

1
Liloba na Nzambe mpe Motatoli na yango

1 Na ebandeli, Ye oyo azali Liloba azalaka ; azalaka elongo na Nzambe, mpe azali Nzambe. 2 Wuta na ebandeli, azalaka elongo na Nzambe. 3 Nzambe akelaki biloko nyonso na nzela na Ye  ; ezali na eloko moko te oyo ekelama soki na nzela na Ye te. 4 Bomoi ewuta epai na Ye, mpe bomoi yango ezalaki pole mpo na bato. 5 Pole engengaka kati na molili, kasi molili eyambaki yango te.

6 Nzambe atindaki moto moko, kombo na ye ezalaki « Yoane. » 7 Ayaki lokola motatoli, mpo na kotatola na tina na pole, mpo ete bato nyonso bandima na nzela na ye. 8 Ye moko Yoane azalaki pole te, kasi ayaki nde mpo na kozala motatoli na tina na pole.

9 Pole ya solo eyaki na mokili, mpe engengisaka bato nyonso. 10 Ye oyo azali Liloba azalaki kati na mokili, pamba te Ye nde akelaki yango, kasi mokili endimaki Ye te. 11 Ayaki epai ya ekolo na Ye, kasi bato ya ekolo na Ye moko bayambaki Ye te ; 12 nzokande bato nyonso oyo bayambaki Ye, ba-oyo bandimelaki Kombo na Ye, apesaki bango makoki ya kokoma bana na Nzambe. 13 Bakomi bana na Nzambe na nzela ya mbotama ya bomoto te, na posa ya bomoto te to mpe na mokano ya moto te, kasi na mokano ya Nzambe.

14 Ye oyo azalaki Liloba akomaki moto mpe avandaki kati na biso, atonda na ngolu mpe na solo. Tomonaki nkembo na Ye, nkembo oyo azwi epai ya Tata na Ye, lokola Mwana se moko.

15 Yoane azalaki kotatola na tina na Ye, na mongongo makasi : « Botala Ye oyo nalobaki na tina na Ye : ‹ Ye oyo azali koya sima na ngai aleki ngai na lokumu, pamba te azalaki liboso ete ngai nazala. › » 16 Lokola atonda na bolingo mpo na biso, apesaki biso ngolu likolo ya ngolu ; 17 pamba te Mibeko eyaki na nzela ya Moyize, kasi ngolu mpe solo eyaki na nzela ya Yesu-Klisto. 18 Moto moko te amona Nzambe, kasi ezali kaka Mwana se moko oyo azali Nzambe mpe azali moko na Tata nde atalisaki biso Ye.

Bimoniseli ya liboso mpe kokoso ya liboso
Litatoli ya Yoane Mobatisi
( Mat 3.1-12; Mlk 1.2-8; Lk 3.15-17)

19 Tala litatoli oyo Yoane apesaki tango bakambi ya Bayuda batindaki, wuta na Yelusalemi, Banganga-Nzambe mpe Balevi, mpo na kotuna ye :

— Yo ozali nani ?

20 Abetaki monoko te, kasi alobaki na bango solo na bonsomi nyonso :

— Ngai, nazali Klisto te.

21 Batunaki ye lisusu  :

— Bongo ozali nani ? Ozali Eliya ?

Azongisaki  :

— Nazali Eliya te.

Batunaki ye lisusu  :

— Ozali mosakoli ?

Azongisaki  :

— Te !

22 Bakobaki kotuna ye  :

— Bongo ozali penza nani ? Ozali koloba nini na tina na yo moko ? Yebisa biso yango, pamba te tosengeli kopesa eyano epai ya bato oyo batindi biso.

23 Yoane azongiselaki bango kolanda ndenge mosakoli Ezayi alobaki  :

— Ngai, nazali mongongo ya moto oyo azali kobelela kati na esobe : « Bobongisa nzela mpo na Nkolo ! »

24 Nzokande batindami yango bazalaki Bafarizeo. 25 Batunaki ye lisusu  :

— Soki ozali Masiya te, Eliya te to mpe mosakoli te, bongo mpo na nini ozali kobatisa ?

26 Yoane azongiselaki bango  :

— Ngai, nazali kobatisa na mayi ; kasi kati na bino, ezali na Moto moko oyo bino boyebi te ; 27 azali koya sima na ngai, mpe ngai nabongi kutu te mpo na kofungola ata basinga ya basandale na Ye.

28 Makambo oyo nyonso esalemaki na Betani, na ngambo mosusu ya Yordani, epai wapi Yoane azalaki kobatisa.

Yesu, Mpate ya Nzambe

29 Mokolo oyo elandaki, wana Yoane amonaki Yesu koya epai na ye, alobaki :

— Tala Mpate ya Nzambe, oyo alongolaka lisumu ya mokili. 30 Ezali na tina na Ye nde nalobaki  : « Ezali na moko oyo azali koya sima na ngai, aleki ngai na lokumu, pamba te azalaki liboso ete ngai nazala. » 31 Ngai moko mpe nayebaki te soki esengelaki kozala nani  ; kasi tina oyo ngai nayaki kobatisa bato na mayi, ezalaki nde mpo ete natalisa Ye epai ya bato ya Isalaele.

32 Bongo Yoane apesaki litatoli oyo  :

— Namonaki Molimo kokita wuta na likolo lokola ebenga mpe kovanda likolo na Ye. 33 Ngai moko mpe nayebaki Ye te  ; kasi Ye oyo atindaki ngai kobatisa na mayi alobaki na ngai : « Moto oyo okomona Molimo kokita mpe kowumela likolo na Ye, Ye nde akobatisa kati na Molimo Mosantu. » 34 Mpe lokola ezali yango nde likambo oyo ngai namonaki, yango wana nazali kotatola : Moto oyo azali Mwana na Nzambe.

Bayekoli ya liboso ya Yesu
( Mat 4.18-22; Mlk 1.16-20; Lk 5.1-11)

35 Mokolo oyo elandaki, wana Yoane azalaki lisusu na esika yango elongo na bayekoli na ye mibale, 36 amonaki Yesu koleka mpe alobaki  : « Botala Mpate ya Nzambe ! »

37 Lokola bayekoli nyonso mibale bayokaki ndenge Yoane alobaki, balandaki Yesu. 38 Bongo tango Yesu abalukaki mpo na kotala na sima, amonaki bango mibale bazali kolanda Ye. Atunaki bango :

— Bolingi nini ?

Bazongisaki  :

— Rabi †, ovandaka wapi ?

39 Yesu azongiselaki bango  :

— Boya mpe bokomona.

Balandaki Yesu, bamonaki esika oyo azalaki kovanda mpe bavandaki elongo na Ye na mokolo wana. Ezalaki na ngonga ya minei sima na midi.

40 Andre, ndeko ya Simona Petelo, azalaki moko kati na bato wana mibale oyo bayokaki maloba ya Yoane mpe balandaki Yesu. 41 Akendeki kokutana na Simona, ndeko na ye, mpe alobaki na ye : « Tomoni Masiya †! » 42 Bongo amemaki Simona epai ya Yesu.

Yesu atalaki Simona mpe alobaki  : « Ozali Simona, mwana mobali ya Yoane ; kasi bakobanda kobenga yo Sefasi † . »

43 Mokolo oyo elandaki, Yesu azwaki mokano ya kokende na Galile. Na nzela, akutanaki na Filipo mpe alobaki na ye :

« Landa Ngai. »

44 Filipo, Andre mpe Petelo bazalaki bato ya engumba Betisaida. 45 Filipo akutanaki na Natanaele mpe alobaki na ye  :

— Tomoni Yesu ya Nazareti, mwana mobali ya Jozefi, oyo Moyize alobela kati na buku ya Mobeko, mpe oyo basakoli balobela.

46 Natanaele atunaki ye  :

— Boni, eloko ya malamu ekoki mpe kobima na Nazareti ?

Filipo azongiselaki ye  :

— Yaka mpe okomona yo moko.

47 Tango Yesu amonaki Natanaele koya epai na Ye, alobaki na tina na ye :

— Tala moto ya Isalaele ya solo-solo oyo, kati na ye, lokuta ezali te !

48 Natanaele atunaki Ye  :

— Oyebi ngai ndenge nini ?

Yesu azongiselaki ye  :

— Liboso ete Filipo abenga yo, wana ozalaki nanu na se ya nzete ya figi, namonaki yo.

49 Natanaele alobaki  :

— Moteyi, ozali solo Mwana na Nzambe ; ozali penza Mokonzi ya Isalaele.

50 Yesu alobaki na ye  :

— Ondimi kaka mpo ete nalobi na yo : Namonaki yo na se ya nzete ya figi ? Okomona lisusu makambo minene koleka oyo.

51 Bongo alobaki lisusu  : « Nazali koloba na bino penza ya solo : bokomona Likolo kofungwama, mpe ba-anjelu ya Nzambe komata mpe kokita mpo na Mwana na Moto. »

Screenshot guide · English · Mac + Windows
Na telefone Android

Landa malako na nse, na molɔngɔ ya banimero.

Files
Luka elilingi oyo ya dossier
Fungola Files

Na telefone na yo, application ekoki kobengama Files, My Files to File Manager.

Kende na Downloads

Ba fichiers oyo ozwi na bibliotɛkɛ oyo ebombamaka awa, longola soki oponaki esika mosusu.

Fina fichier

PDF esɛngi application ya kotanga PDF, MP3 esɛngi application ya koyoka mpe MP4 esɛngi application ya kotala video. Soki telefone esɛngi yo opona application, pona oyo ekoki kofungola lolenge yango ya fichier.

Soki fichier efungwami te

Telefone na yo ekoki kosɛnga application oyo ekoki kofungola lolenge yango ya fichier. Installe application ya kotanga PDF to kotala video ntango ozali nanu na internet.

Na iPhone to iPad

Landa malako na nse, na molɔngɔ ya banimero.

Files
Luka elilingi oyo ya dossier
Fungola Files

Luka elilingi ya dossier ya bleu. Mikanda oyo ozwi na internet ekendaka na Photos te.

Fina Browse, mpe Downloads

Soki Downloads emonani te, fungola iCloud Drive mpe luka Downloads. Soki obombaki na On My iPhone to On My iPad, tala kuna.

Fina fichier

Fina mokanda, enregistrement to video oyo obombi. Soki fichier efungwami te, okoki kosɛnga application oyo ekoki kofungola lolenge yango ya fichier.

Bomba fichier na telefone

Fichier oyo ezali kaka na iCloud Drive ekoki kosɛnga internet. Kopi yango na On My iPhone to On My iPad, mpe tala soki ekoki kofungwama kozanga internet.

Lisalisi mosusu ya Apple

SAMSUNG
Na telefone Samsung

Landa malako na nse, na molɔngɔ ya banimero.

My Files
Luka elilingi oyo ya dossier
Fungola My Files

Luka elilingi ya dossier ya orange. Ekoki kozala na dossier Samsung. Soki omoni yango te, benda écran likoló mpe luka My Files.

Fina Downloads

Ba fichiers oyo ozwi na site ebombamaka mbala mingi awa. Soki oponaki dossier mosusu, tala kuna.

Fina fichier oyo obombi

Fina mokanda, enregistrement to video. Pona application soki telefone esɛngi yo. Soki omoni fichier te, fina bouton ya koluka mpe koma nkombo na yango.

Lisalisi mosusu ya Samsung

Na ordinatɛrɛ
Tala Downloads

Windows: fungola This PC, mpe Downloads. Mac: fungola Finder, mpe Downloads.

Fungola fichier

Salela application ya kotanga PDF, koyoka to kotala video. Soki fichier efungwami te, installe application oyo ekoki kofungola lolenge yango ya fichier.

Mpo na kobomba bibliotɛkɛ mobimba

Kopi nyonso oyo ezali na carte mpe tiká bankombo ya ba dossiers ndenge ezali.

Bakisa bibliotɛkɛ na écran ya ebandeli
Elilingi oyo esalaka nini?

Elilingi na écran ya ebandeli ekosalisa yo ofungola bibliotɛkɛ noki. Zwa mpe bomba ba fichiers oyo olingi kosalela kozanga internet.

Na Android

Fungola bibliotɛkɛ na Chrome. Fina bapwɛ misato, mpe Add to Home screen. Bouton na page ya ebandeli esalaka ndenge moko.

Na iPhone to iPad

Fungola bibliotɛkɛ na Safari. Fina Share, to fungola Page Menu mpe fina Share. Pona Add to Home Screen, mpe fina Add.

Soki option emonani te

Etaleli appareil mpe navigateur na yo. Fungola site ya bibliotɛkɛ to page na Wi-Fi ya VillageServer. Option ekoki komonana te soki ofungoli page mbala moko na carte.

Na Wi-Fi ya VillageServer
Kangama na réseau

Kangama na Wi-Fi ya VillageServer. Wi-Fi oyo ezali na internet te, kasi bibliotɛkɛ ekosala kaka. Ezali ndenge esengeli.

Fungola adresse na navigateur

Koma adresse oyo ezali na kit na navigateur na yo mpo na kofungola bibliotɛkɛ.

Bomba oyo olingi kobatela

Liboso ya kolongwa na Wi-Fi oyo, bomba na appareil na yo ba fichiers oyo olingi kosalela na nsima.

Soki eloko moko esali te
Bibliotɛkɛ efungwami, kasi biloko emonani te

Liste ya biloko ekoki kozala ete efungwami te, to copie esili te. Fungola page lisusu. Soki okopiaki carte, kopi lisusu nyonso mpe tiká bankombo ya ba dossiers ndenge ezali.

Filme ebɛti te

Fichier ekoki kozala mobimba te, to appareil ekoki kofungola lolenge yango ya fichier te. Meka filme mosusu mpe tala soki oyo esɛngi internet. Soki filme moko kaka ebɛti te, kopi to zwa fichier yango lisusu.

Elobi “Esɛngi internet”

Eloko yango ebombamaki na carte te. Kangisa appareil na yo na internet mpo na kofungola yango.

Nazwa fichier oyo nabombi te

Tala liboso Downloads. Soki ezali kuna te, bomba lisusu mpe tala esika telefone elobi ete ezali kobomba yango.

Fungola fichier liboso ya kosalela yango

Fungola fichier sikoyo, ntango ozali nanu na ntango ya kokopi to kozwa yango lisusu soki ezali na mokakatano.

Banzela mosusu, litambe na litambe
AirDrop, Quick Share, câble to carte — mpo na ba appareils mibale nyonso

Câble USB na File Transfer
Kangisa telefone

Salela câble oyo ekoki kotinda ba fichiers. Câble oyo esalaka kaka charge ekoki kotinda ba fichiers te.

Fungola File Transfer

Na Android, fungola notification Charging this device via USB. Fina yango mpe pona File Transfer. Mode ya charge epesaka ordinatɛrɛ nzela ya kofungola ba fichiers te.

Fungola telefone na ordinatɛrɛ

Na Windows, fungola telefone na File Explorer. Na Mac, salela application oyo ekoki kotinda ba fichiers ya Android, to salela LocalSend na ba appareils mibale na Wi-Fi moko.

Kopi fichier

Mpo na kotinda na telefone, kopi fichier na dossier Download to Downloads ya telefone. Mpo na kotinda na ordinatɛrɛ, kopi fichier na telefone na dossier ya ordinatɛrɛ.

Tala fichier oyo ekomi

Na Android, tala Files, Downloads to dossier oyo oponaki. Na ordinatɛrɛ, tala dossier oyo eyambi yango. Fungola fichier mpo na komeka.

Tinda liboso fichier moko ya moke

Meka na PDF moko to enregistrement moko liboso ya kotinda ba fichiers minene. Komeka na fichier ya moke ekosalisa yo omona noki soki connexion ezali na mokakatano.

Sɛnga moto oyo azwi yango ameka mpe

Sɛnga moto oyo azwi fichier atinda yango epai ya moto mosusu sikoyo, wana ozali kotala. Akoyekola kosala yango ye moko.
